description: Comprehensive buff/debuff system for LOM battle engine. Manages creation, tracking, interaction, and destruction of all combat modifiers.

Buff_base_class.description: Base Buff class with lifecycle methods (onBegin, onUpdate, onDestroy, start, stop, execBuff)

BuffCtr.description: Buff controller/manager per unit. Manages buff list, type-based queries, and lifecycle.

ConfigBuff.description: Configuration data class for buff definitions (id, type, group, action, params, etc.)

buffMap_init.description: Registration of all 80 buff class constructors into global buffMap

addBuff_factory.description: Factory method that creates buff instances from ConfigBuff data

configBuff_schema.name: Localized name (data[1] -> GetStrFromConfig)
configBuff_schema.mutex: Mutex/stacking behavior: 1=replace, 2=unique, 3=stack with max, 4=unique per caster, 5=refresh per caster (data[7])
configBuff_schema.action: String key into buffMap for class instantiation (data[10])
configBuff_schema.param5: Class-specific parameter 5, often array (data[15], defaults to LNIL/[])

buffCreationFlow: 1. SkillRunner.addBuff(target, buffId, duration, skillPar) is called
3. IGNORE_BUFFIDS check: if target has ignore buff containing this ID, skip
4. Mutex checks (types 2,4,5): prevent duplicate application based on rules
5. Control immunity check: if target has notControlled/invincible and action is control type, skip
6. Instantiation: buffMap[config.action](config) creates the buff instance
7. Set skillPar, duration (with CONTROL_RES reduction for dizz, shield_time_extra for shields)
9. If type == 0 (instant): execute onBegin + destroy immediately
10. If type > 0 (persistent): add to BuffCtr, manage lifecycle
11. Mutex type 3: refresh existing stack timers, enforce add_max
12. Mutex type 1: stop existing buff with same ID
13. If AddBuffTrigger state active: notify AddBuffTrigger buffs

buffLifecycle.execBuff: Called each frame. Returns false when duration expires.
buffLifecycle.onUpdate: Called each frame with delta time
buffLifecycle.isDestroy: Flag checked by BuffCtr for cleanup

buffQuerying.getBuffByType: Returns all active (non-destroyed) buffs matching a BuffGroupType value
buffQuerying.findBuffByType: Returns boolean if any active buff matches the type
buffQuerying.getBuffListById: Get all buffs with matching config ID
buffQuerying.removeBuff: Stop all buffs of a given type

damageInteractionPipeline.description: The order in which buff systems interact during damage calculation (used by BuffSkillValue and BuffBleed)

steps.description: Check if skill should be reflected/returned. If yes, interrupt and skip damage.
Calculate raw damage from calType (ATK-DEF, HP%, attribute, etc.)
Apply skill factor and active skill damage multiplier
Add flat bonus damage from caster's SKILL_DAMAGE_ADD buffs
Multiply by skill damage extra attribute (unless T1045 flag)
Check for skill crit: damage *= (1 + skill_crit_dam), then pow(damage, 0.98)
critMul = max(1.5, crit_dam / max(0.5, crit_def))
If target is Boss and boss_dam > 0: damage *= (1 + boss_dam)
Add record damage bonus: damage *= (1 + recordDamage / 10000)
Multiply by counterDamage multiplier from skill
Apply type-appropriate resistance (skill_resist, att_resist, etc.)
Apply general hurt modifiers (fragile, suppress/inspire, etc.)
Post-calculation multiplicative damage bonus (HP-loss scaling)
HP-difference bonus damage (target HP vs owner HP)
healthTarget(target, damage, healthType)
If skill crit occurred, trigger state triggers
Skill-specific HP steal (separate from VAMPIRE)
Deal additional true damage as percentage of dealt damage
Life steal healing for the caster based on damage dealt
Trigger skill effects with HP_Hurt trigger type

shieldInteractionPipeline.description: Shield damage absorption happens before the damage pipeline

systems.description: Shield absorbs incoming damage (onShieldAction returns absorbed amount)
Tiered damage reduction based on damage-to-HP ratio
Absorbs portion of damage, releases over time
Records HP history, can restore past HP state on trigger
Prevents lethal damage, sets HP to minimum

triggerSystems.description: Buff systems that react to game events

keyFormulas.vampireHeal: round(damage * totalDamMul) / injuryReduce * skillDamFactor capped at hpMaxRatio

globalBattleFactors.injuryReduce: Global damage/injury reduction multiplier applied to HP%-based damage
globalBattleFactors.shieldDecay: Global shield HP decay factor (reduces shield effectiveness over battle)
globalBattleFactors.treatDecay: Global healing decay factor (reduces healing over battle)
globalBattleFactors.total_damage_add_down_limit: Minimum floor for total damage multiplier (from ConfigGlobal)
